name: inspira-dither-shader
title: Dither Shader
description: A canvas that redraws an image in a choice of dither patterns: ordered dots, halftone blobs, noise or crosshatch, in grayscale, duotone or custom palettes.
use: An image should take on a printed, one-bit or retro look and the pattern must be switchable live.
avoid: It redraws every pixel on the CPU, so large canvases or the animated noise mode can stutter.
a11y: The canvas is labelled as an image but with a generic description, and the optional animation ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide photo of hills and sky is reduced to hard black and white, built from tiny dots or blocky shapes. Under it sit two rows of small pill buttons for pattern and colour mode, one highlighted in each row.
behaves: Choosing a pattern or colour button redraws the image immediately in that style. Brightness, contrast and threshold reshape how much turns black or white, and an optional loop animates the noise.
customise: src, gridSize, ditherMode, colorMode, palette colours, brightness, contrast, threshold, objectFit and animated/speed are props; the patterns themselves are fixed.
weight: moderate: Redraws the whole image pixel by pixel on the CPU; only heavy when animated is on.
